name: hallab-factual-verification-benchmark
description: Claim-level factual verification benchmark with traceable evidence and human-approved labels.
status_notice: UNDER DEVELOPMENT. Candidates and proposed labels are AI-authored and provisional. Only human-APPROVED items form the benchmark.
partition_rule: partition = dev if int(item_id hex) % 3 == 0 else test (deterministic, about 1/3 dev and 2/3 held-out test)
